# tests/integration/test_order_fulfillment.py
import pytest
from testcontainers.compose import DockerCompose
from unittest.mock import patch
import asyncio

@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def services():
    """The lab. Everything we need, contained."""
    with DockerCompose(".", compose_file_name="docker-compose.test.yml") as compose:
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8080/health")  # Order
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8081/health")  # Inventory
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8082/health")  # Payment
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8083/health")  # Notification
        yield compose

@pytest.fixture
def isolated_order(services, db_session):
    """Each test gets its own territory. No contamination."""
    order_id = f"TEST-{uuid4()}"
    db_session.execute("INSERT INTO orders (id, status) VALUES (?, 'pending')", order_id)
    yield order_id
    db_session.execute("DELETE FROM orders WHERE id LIKE 'TEST-%'")

class TestHappyPath:
    """The cook goes perfectly. Every time."""
    
    async def test_complete_order_flow(self, services, isolated_order):
        # Setup: Product with sufficient inventory
        await inventory_client.set_stock("PRODUCT-A", 100)
        
        # Execute: The formula
        response = await order_client.create_order(
            order_id=isolated_order,
            items=[{"sku": "PRODUCT-A", "qty": 2}],
            payment={"method": "card", "token": "tok_valid"}
        )
        
        # Assertions: Say my name
        assert response.status == "confirmed"
        assert await inventory_client.get_stock("PRODUCT-A") == 98
        assert await payment_client.get_charge(isolated_order) is not None
        assert await notification_client.was_sent(isolated_order, "order_confirmed")

class TestServiceFailures:
    """When things go wrong. And they will."""
    
    async def test_inventory_insufficient_triggers_rejection(self, services, isolated_order):
        await inventory_client.set_stock("PRODUCT-B", 0)
        
        response = await order_client.create_order(
            order_id=isolated_order,
            items=[{"sku": "PRODUCT-B", "qty": 1}]
        )
        
        assert response.status == "rejected"
        assert response.reason == "insufficient_inventory"
        # No payment attempted
        assert await payment_client.get_charge(isolated_order) is None
    
    async def test_payment_failure_unreserves_inventory(self, services, isolated_order):
        await inventory_client.set_stock("PRODUCT-C", 10)
        
        response = await order_client.create_order(
            order_id=isolated_order,
            items=[{"sku": "PRODUCT-C", "qty": 2}],
            payment={"method": "card", "token": "tok_decline"}
        )
        
        # Compensating transaction executed
        assert response.status == "payment_failed"
        assert await inventory_client.get_stock("PRODUCT-C") == 10  # Unreserved

class TestTimeoutAndRetry:
    
    @patch('services.payment.client.TIMEOUT', 0.1)
    async def test_payment_timeout_triggers_retry_then_compensation(self, services, isolated_order):
        await payment_client.inject_latency(500)  # 500ms delay
        
        response = await order_client.create_order(...)
        
        assert await payment_client.attempt_count(isolated_order) == 3  # Retried
        assert response.status == "failed"
